previousLiveFollowSlice.details: Follow request produced accepted decision, skill start, low-level movement, and server evidence. Not a formal client or long-term gate.

latestLiveMovement.fixtureConstraint: Bounded straight safe course with an embedded GameTest player; not a rendered client or random world.

latestReleaseAudit.details: Full offline Gradle JUnit, release build, verifyReleaseJar, compatibility checker, and 61 Python E2E tests passed after the combat fix. Public documentation Han scan and git diff check passed.
